title: [Master]-"The record in table Reminder Line already exists." error appears if you Create Reminders for a Customer with all the Open Entries On Hold and no Reminder Free applied on the Reminder Terms used
summary: Fixed a duplicate record error in Reminder Communication when creating reminders for customers with all open entries on hold and no reminder free amount on the reminder terms.
key_points: Resolves duplicate record existence error in Reminder Line table
Applies to reminders for customers with all open entries marked as on hold
Affects scenarios where reminder terms have no reminder free amount configured
Fixes issue in Reminder Communication codeunit
